semantics.identity_rule: Studio, Lens, preset, source and analysis-run identities remain distinct.
semantics.action_rule: Create/edit/run/save-preset operations invoke separate authorized canonical operations.
semantics.authority_rule: Viewing or running a Lens does not grant new source authority.
semantics.result_rule: Monitor distinguishes derived analysis results from accepted/persisted canonical data.
semantics.trace_rule: Displayed result retains exact source/Lens/preset/backend refs.
semantics.layout_rule: Visual grouping does not create Topic/source relations.

invariants.rule: Studio and Lens compose and project existing canonical semantics; analysis, presets and visualizations never silently become source semantic authority.

hard_gates.condition: monitor directly persists analysis as canonical source
